quotes.quote: Kindness in words creates confidence. Kindness in thinking creates profoundness. Kindness in giving creates love.

quotes.quote: When you know you can do something, and you feel good about yourself, you do not have to devalue others.

quotes.quote: Kindness and caring are ambrosia for the soul.
quotes.author: Amy Leigh Mercree

quotes.quote: Dance through life flinging kindness like shimmering rainbows. Find your bliss by sharing your heart.
quotes.author: Amy Leigh Mercree

quotes.quote: Be a person that others will look for your posts daily because they know you will encourage them. Be the positive one and help others to have a great day and you will find that not only they like you but you will like you too.
quotes.author: John Patrick Hickey,  Oops! Did I Really Post That

quotes.quote: Caring is what matters, not stuff or status, just people sharing kindness & joy in a web of the heart that spans the globe.
quotes.author: Amy Leigh Mercree

quotes.quote: Your comfort zone is a place where you keep yourself in a self-illusion and nothing can grow there but your potentiality can grow only when you can think and grow out of that zone.
quotes.author: Rashedur Ryan Rahman

quotes.quote: Nurturing a feeling makes it proliferate. Choose wisely. Joy, kindness, love, & caring will illuminate your life.
quotes.author: Amy Leigh Mercree

quotes.quote: Being present to yourself in love and with kindness is the ultimate gift.
quotes.author: Amy Leigh Mercree

quotes.quote: Be kind to him who does not deserve your kindness.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: A hug is a priceless gift of love and kindness.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: Measure your life not by the dimension of your bank account but by the expansion of your kindness and love.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: Next to love, kindness is the most beautiful thing.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: Kindness is the beauty of the heart and the smiles of the mind.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: I am a farmer of kindness and compassion; I plant the seeds of love in my garden.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: Kindness is the greatest medicine that can heal all ills.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: When kindness is your religion, then caring is your prayer.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: The most powerful force that can transform an enemy into a friend is simple kindness.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: Like a rose bud, my heart always desires to bloom and spread the fragrance of love, beauty, and kindness of mankind.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: Paint your life with the colors of kindness so that you may find the true bliss of happiness.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: Be mindful. Be grateful. Be positive. Be true. Be kind.
quotes.author: Roy T. Bennett,  The Light in the Heart

quotes.quote: Treat everyone with politeness and kindness, not because they are nice, but because you are.
quotes.author: Roy T. Bennett,  The Light in the Heart

quotes.quote: Kind words change the world.
quotes.author: A.D. Posey

quotes.quote: Greatness is achieved through kindness, compassion, and love.
quotes.author: A.D. Posey

quotes.quote: Peace begins in the mind with a simple thought of love and kindness for all.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: With love and kindness, grow peace in your mind and then spread it with joy.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: Be a vessel of forgiveness and kindness in order to be a fountain of peace.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: Burdens of life become lighter when your heart is filled with love and we learn to forgive and forget with profound kindness.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: Love is a flower that grows in the garden of mind if we treat it with kindness, compassion, and joy.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: Love, kindness, compassion, and forgiveness are the secrets of all peace and happiness.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: Love is my religion, kindness is my prayer, forgiveness is my temple, and peace is my abode.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: If you surround yourself with flowers of love, peace, and kindness, you will always find yourself in a garden of joy and happiness.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: The fire of kindness can melt the most hateful heart.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: Kindness is the language of eternal consciousness.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: Win the heart with love and win the hate with kindness.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: When you are motivated by the kindness and wellbeing of humanity, then nothing can scare or derail you.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: Simply just BE GRATEFUL what you have today, there is millions who'are crying for the place where you are today
quotes.author: Rashedur Rahman

quotes.quote: You can be kind only when you are in love.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: Be an advocate of love and kindness.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: Be a fountain of love, positivity, kindness, and abundance.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: Kindness is the master key which opens the gates of inner bliss.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: Love and kindness are a kind of gun that we can use to change everyone without hurting anyone.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha
